basic.description:
{Basic Warband Oath}

Einherjar Warband formation effects ×1.25, souls +20%.
Ragnarok can trigger once Odin's Wain lights 7 stars.

 {#F800F8|Synergies} 
 {#002366|Ymir Frost Giant}: Ymir Frost Giants Attack and Defense +2.
 {#D7D7D7|Leadership}: troops in formation get Morale +1 this round.
 {#D7D7D7|Armorer}: Shield Wall ranged reduction +5% more.
 {#D7D7D7|Soul Offering}: after an offering, troops in formation get Attack +2 this round.

basic.description:
{Basic Soul Offering}

When the hero casts a Norse god power, it spends souls (up to 25% of a step),
raising the spell's effect in proportion, up to +15%.
Spent souls no longer count toward recalls.

 {#F800F8|Synergies} 
 {#002366|Ginnungagap Titan}: Ginnungagap Titans Attack and Defense +2.
 {#D7D7D7|Sorcery}: effect cap +10% more.
 {#C5FFA5|Ragnarok}: that round, god powers spend no souls and use the cap.
 {#D7D7D7|Warband Oath}: after an offering, troops in formation get Attack +2 this round.
